For fixed vertex and edge masses the stated six-square identity is exact, and AM–GM has simultaneous equality exactly at constant masses within each orbit. The resulting scalar ratio has derivative -4t(2t³+3t²-6t-3)/(3(1+t²)³), unique positive stationary root by Descartes, and strictly smaller endpoint limits 5/3. Three pair-sum equalities force affine phases. Replayed CHECK.py from its packaged source and verified symbolic identities including resultant, root isolation, 75 grid comparisons and 25 complex coefficient samples. Finite checks do not substitute for the proof.
